items.title: Carly Rae Jepsen Announces ‘Day and Night’ North American 2027 Tour Dates
items.summary: Carly Rae Jepsen has announced her upcoming “Day and Night” 2027 North American tour, with stops at Los Angeles’ Kia Forum and New York City’s Madison Square Garden.

items.title: Naomi Bulochnikov-Paul Joins Netflix As Head Of TV Communications
items.summary: One of the most sought after jobs in TV corporate communications over the past year has been filled. Naomi Bulochnikov-Paul is joining Netflix as VP of Communications, Series, heading TV communications.

items.title: Erik Bright Joins PMK Entertainment As Executive Vice President Of Content And Strategic Communications
items.summary: Veteran comms executive Erik Bright has joined PMK Entertainment as Executive Vice President, Content and Strategic Communications.

items.title: Venom’s Conrad “Cronos” Lant Dead At 63
items.summary: Conrad "Cronos" Lant, longtime singer and bassist for the pioneering English underground metal band Venom, has passed away. The band announced Lant's passing in a social media post today.
